      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "tips=sns.load_dataset(\"tips\")\n",
        "bill=tips[\"total_bill\"].values\n",
        "ip=tips[\"tip\"].values"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "lsqR92vcDiww"
      },
      "execution_count": 3,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "def local_weight(x0, X, tau):\n",
        "    return np.exp(np.sum((X - x0) ** 2, axis=1) / (-2 * tau * tau))\n",
        "\n",
        "def local_regression(X, y, tau):\n",
        "    y_pred = np.zeros(len(X))\n",
        "    for i in range(len(X)):\n",
        "        weights = local_weight(X[i], X, tau)\n",
        "        W = np.diag(weights)\n",
        "        theta = np.linalg.pinv(X.T @ W @ X) @ (X.T @ W @ y)\n",
        "        y_pred[i] = X[i] @ theta\n",
        "    return y_pred"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "0IQzwe7PI7tU"
      },
      "execution_count": 6,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "X = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(bill)), bill))\n",
        "y = ip # Using 'ip' as defined in previous cell\n",
        "tau = 0.5\n",
        "y_pred = local_regression(X, y, tau)\n",
        "sort_idx = np.argsort(bill)\n",
        "xsort = bill[sort_idx]\n",
        "ysort = y_pred[sort_idx]\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))\n",
        "plt.scatter(bill, ip, color=\"green\", label=\"Data\") # Using 'ip' for scatter plot\n",
        "plt.plot(xsort, ysort, color=\"red\", linewidth=5, label=\"Locally Weighted Regression\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Total bill\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Tip\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Non-Parametric Locally Weighted Regression\")\n",
        "plt.legend()\n",
        "plt.grid(True)\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
